commonCategory: Functions relating to networking (host names, IP addresses, etc.) or making remote calls.
commonDescription:
Sends an HTTP GET request and converts a JSON response body to XML using `json-to-xml()`. A `404`
response produces an empty sequence.
commonReturnDescription: The XML representation of the JSON response, or an empty sequence when no usable response is returned.
name: fetch-json

args.description: Optional JSON HTTP client configuration, including SSL settings.
args.name: clientConfig
